name: The Pigeon

revision.note: Rewritten from the human-performer reading to a photoreal CGI animal.

rendering.rule: bible/cultivation.json SUP-002 (amended BIB-0027); placed in the treetops where Alice's stretched neck arrives (SUP-003)
rendering.species: common wood pigeon (Columba palumbus), the large British pigeon
rendering.limits: Bird anatomy throughout; speech by beak and throat movement. No clothing, no cartoon face. She beats Alice with her wings; no pecking injury.

gender_note.reason: The source calls the Pigeon 'it'; she is guarding her own eggs ('hatching the eggs', ch005-p66) and settles back 'into its nest' (ch005-p77); index.json also registers her as female.

base_age_note.quote: I’ve seen a good many little girls in my time
base_age_note.reason: Persona age kept for voice casting. As an animal: an adult wood pigeon, worn and ruffled from three sleepless weeks.

hair.color: blue-grey body, pinkish-mauve breast, white neck patch edged with iridescent green and violet, white wing bars, dark grey tail band
hair.style: ruffled and frayed from three weeks of sleeplessness; puffs up huge when she attacks
hair.quote: I haven’t had a wink of sleep these three weeks!
hair.reason: Species plumage; the ruffled state carries the sourced sleeplessness.

skin.tone: pink-red feet; yellow-tipped reddish bill with a white cere

face.shape: small round head on a heavy chest

build.height_note: Perched height; total length 40-42 cm, wingspan about 75 cm, species-true.
build.posture: puffed chest, wings half-raised; flies at Alice's face beating her with her wings; screams and settles back onto the nest
build.quote: a large pigeon had flown into her face, and was beating her violently with its wings

scale_reference.in_scene: Alice's head, at full size, arrives at treetop level on her enormously stretched neck (SUP-003); the Pigeon is natural size beside that head, about the size of Alice's face with wings spread wider.

marks.description: white neck patch with green-violet iridescence, her identifier
a flimsy twig nest with two white eggs in the fork of the tree, which she settles back onto
marks.quote: as it settled down again into its nest
marks.reason: Wood pigeons lay two white eggs.

default_outfit_tone.summary: none: she wears nothing; her look is the grey wood-pigeon plumage
default_outfit_tone.reason: The text gives her no clothing; per SUP-002 (BIB-0027) the old silk dress, shawl and bonnet are dropped.

prompt_base_en: photoreal large wood pigeon among treetop branches, blue-grey ruffled frayed plumage, pinkish-mauve breast, white neck patch with green and violet iridescence, white wing bars, pale yellow staring eye, wings half-raised and puffed up in alarm beside a twig nest with two white eggs, natural bird anatomy, live-action film plate
